sheet.about.heading: About this map
sheet.about.body: A hand-made model of India: terrain from open elevation data, official state boundaries, in English and Hindi. Drag to pan, pinch to zoom, twist to turn, drag with two fingers to tilt.
sheet.next: Tap a state to select it, then Explore to lift it out. Coming next: rivers, roads, railways, languages, places, food and festivals.
sheet.credits.heading: Data and credits
sheet.credits.boundaries: State boundaries and the outline of India: DataMeet community maps (CC BY 4.0), from Census of India and Survey of India sources.
sheet.credits.terrain: Elevation: AWS Terrain Tiles (Mapzen Terrarium), built from SRTM, GMTED2010, ETOPO1 and other open datasets.
sheet.credits.code: Built with three.js. Source on GitHub.

fallback.webgl: This browser cannot show the 3D map (WebGL2 is needed). India has 28 states and 8 union territories; a text version of the content is on its way.
